agency.description: Capacity realized through an Agent's situated access, orientation, action repertoire, authority, and feedback.

meaning.description: Attributed significance arising for an Agent within a relationship, arena, and horizon.

publicMission.canonicalPurpose: Make consequential couplings and relationship states inspectable so distinct agents can establish shared reference, coordinate direction, take bounded action, and learn from consequences without losing authorship.

promotionGate.rule: Emphasis, repetition, fluency, artifact polish, or a generated narrative cannot promote a downstream mechanism into the ontology root or public mission.

sourceIntentRule.rule: An explicitly described internal mechanism, flywheel, implementation detail, or governance process remains subordinate unless a separate constitutional promotion is accepted.
sourceIntentRule.example: Graduation of agency is an internal proof-gated governance mechanism, not YAWN's root subject or terminal purpose.
